selection_policy.typical: Near median of image-level median replacement counts; no outcome-based ranking.
selection_policy.helpful: C correct, U wrong on the same task at seed 2041; geometric-margin improvement >=0.005. Rank by repair and positive-margin consistency across three existing seeds.
selection_policy.boundary: Replacement count at least pair-level Q75; no primary accuracy improvement on either task and nonpositive C-U margin gain averaged across tasks/seeds. Prioritize repeatable harm, then change count near Q75.
selection_policy.role: Purposefully selected qualitative examples, not aggregate performance estimates.

preprocessing.transform_source:
def _transform(n_px):
    return Compose([
        Resize(n_px, interpolation=BICUBIC),
        CenterCrop(n_px),
        _convert_image_to_rgb,
        ToTensor(),
        Normalize((0.48145466, 0.4578275, 0.40821073), (0.26862954, 0.26130258, 0.27577711)),
    ])
preprocessing.visual_overlay: Render scores and masks on the 224x224 resized-and-center-cropped RGB image, before normalization.
preprocessing.indexing: Patch indices 0..195 in row-major 14x14 grid. Saved patch_indices has 196 columns, with the first 98 valid selected positions followed by -1 padding.
preprocessing.crop_asset_generation: Server existing CLIP _transform(224) first three operations: bicubic shorter-side Resize224, CenterCrop224, RGB. Applied after original.convert(RGB), before normalization.

cases.selection_reason: Representative Pets case: both image-level and selected-pair replacement counts are at the dataset median (14). Image chosen for visibility among median-ranked candidates, without outcome-based ranking.
Representative Flowers case: image-level median replacement count 20.5 equals the dataset image-median center; selected pair replaces 21 tokens, the pair-level median.
Illustrative helpful case: on fixed task B (love in the mist vs petunia), C repairs U errors in all three seeds. For seed 2041, swapping in C_A also changes task B from correct to wrong.
cases.figure_note: Use A’s selection on B: wrong

cases.selection_reason: Illustrative boundary: selected sets differ by 24 patches (Flowers pair Q75). On fixed task A (cape flower vs pelargonium), C is wrong and U correct for seeds 2041 and 2042; C-U margin is negative across all three seeds. Task B margin improves at seed 2041.
